category: Design Software to Meet Security Requirements and Mitigate Risks (PW)
subcategory_text: Identify and use secure design patterns, principles, and reference architectures to reduce the risk of design-level vulnerabilities.
implementation_examples: Apply the principle of least privilege to all design components
Use vetted cryptographic libraries and established key-management patterns
Adopt defence-in-depth design with documented trust boundaries
assessment_objectives: Determine whether secure design principles and patterns are adopted.
Determine whether the design references vetted building blocks rather than bespoke cryptography or auth.
